content.comment_body: Hello! I have attached my project in [product_name]. Given several inputs, each with a unique text message that triggers the same output, I would like to ensure that the message displayed remains locked to the first input triggered. How can I achieve this?
Hi [user_name], Since I am not familiar with your other inputs, I created a basic setup that matches your requirements. I hope this helps and fits what you need.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking for a way to configure their system so that when multiple inputs are triggered, the display locks onto the message from the first input and ignores later triggers. This highlights a need for improved control logic with prioritization and message locking capabilities in the interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the system to allow configuration so that the display shows only the message associated with the first-activated input and ignores later inputs until a reset occurs.
